title: Buying tickets for a musical
instructionsHu: Egy barátoddal Londonban vagy, és ma estére szeretnétek jegyet venni egy musicalre. Beszélj a jegypénztárossal, és intézd el a jegyvásárlást. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are in London with a friend for a few days. You would like to see a musical tonight, so you go to the theatre box office in the afternoon. You can spend about £40 per person.
situation.candidateRole: You are a tourist who wants to buy two tickets.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is the assistant at the box office.
goals: Ask if there are any tickets left for tonight's show.
Ask about the prices and whether there are cheaper tickets for students.
Choose your seats and say why.
Find out when the show starts and finishes.
situation.examinerOpening: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Riverside Theatre. How can I help?

followUpQuestions: Yes, we still have some seats. They're forty-five pounds downstairs and twenty-eight pounds upstairs in the balcony. Which would you like?
Are you students? If you have a student card, you get ten per cent off.
Here you are. How would you like to pay, by card or in cash?

usefulPhrases.en: Are there any tickets left for tonight?
usefulPhrases.hu: Van még jegy a ma esti előadásra?

usefulPhrases.en: We'd like two seats next to each other.
What time does the show start?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Riverside Theatre. How can I help?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Good afternoon. Are there any tickets left for tonight's show? My friend and I would like two, please.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Yes, we still have some seats.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Great. How much are they? And are there any cheaper tickets for students?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: They're forty-five pounds downstairs and twenty-eight pounds upstairs in the balcony. If you have a student card, you get ten per cent off.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Then we'll take two seats in the balcony, please, because downstairs is too expensive for us. Could we sit in the front row? I think we'd see the whole stage from there.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Yes, there are two seats free in the front row. Anything else?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: What time does the show start, and when does it finish? We have to take the Underground back to our hostel, so we don't want to be too late.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: It starts at half past seven and finishes at about ten past ten. So that's two student tickets: fifty pounds forty altogether. How would you like to pay, by card or in cash?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: By card, please. Here you are, and here are our student cards.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Thank you. Here are your tickets. Enjoy the show!

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó mind az öt szempontot sorban teljesíti – megkérdezi, van-e még jegy, rákérdez az árakra és a diákkedvezményre, indoklással helyet választ, megtudja a kezdés és a befejezés idejét, végül fizet –, a 40 fontos keretet is figyelembe veszi.
Szókincs: a jegyvásárlás szavai és fordulatai pontosak (tickets left, balcony, front row, student card, by card, the Underground).
Nyelvhelyesség: a kérdések szórendje hibátlan (Are there any tickets left …? What time does the show start?), az udvarias kérés (Could we sit …?) és a „we'll take …” döntés is helyes.
Érdemes megtanulni: „Are there any tickets left for tonight's show?”, „Are there any cheaper tickets for students?”, „Then we'll take two seats in the balcony”, „By card, please.”.
